theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lip_orthonormal_coordinates
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (T₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))), Module.finrank ℝ T₀ = n → ∃ (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) ∧ (∀ v, ι v ∈ T₀) ∧ (∀ x, ∃ v w, x = ι v + ι' w) ∧ (∀ v w, T₀.starProjection (ι v + ι' w) = ι v)
